about.heading: Know Who
about.description: Hi, I'm Malek Ba Abbad from Yemen, a graduate of Yarmouk University in Jordan, and a passionate Front-End & Web Application Engineer with 5+ years of experience building scalable digital platforms and enterprise interfaces.
about.focus: I specialize in the modern JavaScript and TypeScript ecosystem using React.js, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS, alongside practical backend and CMS experience with Laravel and MySQL. My engineering philosophy centers on clean architecture, low-bandwidth speed, and accessible, responsive user experiences.
about.arabwdoss: I currently work as a React Developer at ArabWare Dos, leading frontend development for critical digital platforms and flagship systems including:
about.bank: Architecting the modern web interface for Bin Dowal Islamic Microfinance Bank using Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
about.wallet: Developing the Bin Dowal Pay E-Wallet portal — Yemen's leading electronic payment gateway — and the interactive Gold Wallet FinTech platform.
about.baligne: Engineering responsive enterprise dashboards such as the Balleghny workflow system, Enterprise HRMS, and the Interactive Digital Signage Kiosk SPA.
about.responsive: I am committed to delivering technical solutions that not only fulfill complex business workflows but also guarantee accessibility, security, and lightning-fast performance across every device.

timeline.desc: Leading frontend architecture for banking portals, e-wallets, and enterprise dashboards using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
Designed, built, and deployed 19+ web platforms across FinTech, renewable energy, marine logistics, healthcare, and government sectors.
Strong academic foundation in software engineering principles, algorithms, database systems, and web technologies.
